title: CRM contact sync locking customer records

verification.methodology: pact business verification (database + checkout SLO + protected ops)

checks.name: database_clear
checks.detail: No lock waits: no session is blocked.

audit.report: The CRM contact sync batch job (pid 1271225) became stuck idle in transaction for 4.2 seconds, holding locks that blocked all checkout sessions and collapsed success rate to 0% with $18,400/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the job, which is classified as BATCH_REPLAYABLE with a 10-minute replay cost and may_interrupt policy. The Continuity Guardian accepted after calculating that waiting would cost ~$182,712 and exceed the 60-second degradation tolerance. Authority authorized the termination, which completed in 164.2 seconds. Verification confirmed full recovery: zero lock waits, 100% checkout success over 10 seconds, and no protected settlements affected.
audit.root_cause: A stuck batch_replayable_crm_contact_sync transaction (idle in transaction for 4.2s with last statement SELECT 1) held locks that blocked all checkout sessions.
lessons: For batch_replayable_crm_contact_sync: add an idle-in-transaction timeout or transaction guard to prevent stuck jobs from holding locks indefinitely, since this workload is replayable with may_interrupt policy.

For batch_replayable_crm_contact_sync: implement lock monitoring with automatic alerts when this job holds locks longer than 30 seconds, given its 600s typical runtime and history of similar incidents (product_feed_rebuild, email_digest_render, fraud_*).
For batch_replayable_crm_contact_sync: verify the job's transaction logic ensures it commits or rolls back promptly after SELECT 1 health checks, rather than remaining idle in transaction.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian efficiently gathered all required evidence (workload registry, change calendar, protected settlements, business impact) in a single round, and the Continuity Guardian accepted immediately based on the clear cost-benefit analysis showing waiting cost ($182,712) far exceeded termination cost (10-minute replay).
follow_ups: Add idle-in-transaction timeout configuration for batch_worker role to automatically terminate stuck transactions.
Review batch_replayable_crm_contact_sync code path to understand why it executes SELECT 1 then idles without committing.
Add this incident pattern to the memory store for faster recognition in future negotiations.
